ABOUT

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE STUDIO

With Harsha & Vijay

We look for more than a beautiful photograph. We look for the people, the feeling, and the little things that make a day yours.
Two perspectives, one shared belief: the photographs that matter are the ones that bring you back.

WE capture more than the celebrations you see; we preserve the little moments unfolding in between. A parent's quiet smile, a friend's laughter, a glance exchanged, and every emotion that makes your story beautifully yours.

We are Harsha Sawnani and Vijay Sawnani, the people behind Your Wed Stories. Through photographs and films, our studio follows the celebration and the connections that give it meaning.
